displayName.description: Plural name of the collection, e.g. "Blog Posts". Must be unique on the site.

singularName.label: Singular Name
singularName.description: Name of one item, e.g. "Blog Post".

slug.label: Slug
slug.description: URL part for the collection, e.g. "blog-posts". Webflow derives it from the name when empty.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Custom fields as a JSON array, each {"type", "displayName", "isRequired"?, "helpText"?}. type is one of Color, DateTime, Email, File, Image, Link, MultiImage, Number, Phone, PlainText, RichText, Switch, VideoLink; Option needs "metadata": {"options": [{"name": "..."}]}; Reference and MultiReference need "metadata": {"collectionId": "..."}.
